h1: Saudi Arabia work visa from the UK
intro: Got a job in Saudi Arabia? Before your work visa is issued you need a medical, an ACRO police certificate and your degree certificate attested. We arrange the medical, the attestations and the visa application in one service, and the calculator below shows your total.
eligibility: You have a job offer from an employer in Saudi Arabia
Your employer has issued your work visa reference
You have a degree or qualification for the role

sections.heading: What we arrange for you
sections.text:
- Medical tests and report at our partner clinic in Manchester or London
- Solicitor and FCO attestation of your degree certificate
- FCO attestation of your medical report and ACRO police certificate
- Your work visa application, checked and submitted to the Saudi visa centre

sections.heading: How long does a Saudi work visa take?
sections.text: The visa itself is usually issued in about 4 working days. Allow extra time beforehand for the medical, your ACRO police certificate and the attestations.

sections.heading: Saudi work visa help from Manchester
sections.text: We're based in Manchester city centre and help professionals across the UK start jobs in Saudi Arabia. Tick the extras you need in the calculator and we'll confirm the final price before you pay. We also offer [document legalisation](/document-legalisation/) for other certificates.

faqs.q: Does my degree need to be attested for a Saudi work visa?
faqs.a: Yes, in most cases. It's certified by a solicitor first, then attested by the FCO.

faqs.q: Where do I have my medical?
faqs.a: At our partner clinic in Manchester or London. Choose the one that suits you in the calculator.

faqs.q: Do I need a police certificate?
faqs.a: Yes. You need an ACRO police certificate, which is then attested by the FCO.
